newsitem.title: UK: F1 float likely to be delayed until September.
newsitem.headline: F1 float likely to be delayed until September.

text.p: The planned flotation of motor racing's Formula One Holdings is likely to be delayed until September, sources close to the discussions said on Friday.

The sources said a final decision on whether to press on with a flotation in July would not be taken until early next week. But the chances of a postponement until September were rated as "fairly high".
Formula One Holdings, controlled by Bernie Ecclestone, runs the commercial side of the world motor racing championship and sells television rights to the annual round of grand prix races.
The business is likely to attract an overall valuation of 1.5 billion pounds ($2.4 billion) or more.

However, there have been complications over the division of revenue between the teams and a floated Formula One business. A delay would also allow bankers and financial advisers longer to market the sale of a unique business.($ = 0.613 British Pounds)
